test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following phenomena is not related to the monsoon in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Western Disturbance.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Western disturbances** originate from the** Mediterranean Sea**, Black Sea, and Atlantic Ocean and reach the **northwestern regions** of India through westerly winds.
 
• They cause rain and snowfall mainly in the winter season in North India and Pakistan. They are very important for **Rabi** crops like wheat.
 
• Western disturbances cause heavy snowfall
